purpose: Fixed stack reply and event candidate vs stock: one-method registration CPU and loop wall time only
statistical_unit: One physical paired window yields one ratio of sums across 20 equal-size segments per side. Ten independent windows per comparator; never treat 40 segments as independent trials.
preflight: Completed R99 A/A retained separately. Stack candidate must pass physical 32-unit/protocol differential, four requested-heap windows, and six build-host gates before timing. Verify all identities/cleanup each window.
production: stock C throughout; only new disposable namespace processes are pinned; no governor/IRQ/production affinity changes
failure_rule: Stop on identity, correctness, collection, health, affinity or cleanup failure. Preserve failed window; never infer success from missing results.
design: Two independently started subject daemons pinned CPU 1; one serial client pinned CPU 0. Ten quartets alternating slot ABBA/BAAB, 2000 untimed warmup cycles per segment. Randomized candidate/baseline slot assignment per window and randomized comparator order per suite block. This co-resident comparison is diagnostic, not full-system latency/memory acceptance.
previous_data: Separate from both A/A calibrations and all older client/workload matrices; no pooling. Endpoint is conditional on this client and paired process arrangement.
comparison_family: Three baselines x four planned metrics = 12 simultaneous intervals. Ten independent paired windows per baseline; segment requests are not replicates.
slot_semantics: Both slots use uploaded unmodified ELF bytes; driver implementation=rs selects upload handling, not both languages. Actual implementations are determined by frozen hashes above; stock hash is the exact original C binary.
interpretation_rule: Intervals require frozen family multiplicity and independent paired-run assumptions. Interleaved A/A median interval (-0.75%,+1.24%) did not meet +/-0.5% calibration. Changes near 1%, including point effects <=2% in magnitude, remain unconfirmed pending independent evidence; do not use an arbitrary 1% sign gate. Large effects still require interval direction, every adverse metric is reported, and no automatic runtime retention or full ubusd superiority is claimed.
